create_ivf_pq_index: create an IVF index with product quantization using faiss.index_factory with string config
create_hnsw_index: create an HNSW graph index with optional scalar or product quantization storage
create_nsg_index: create a navigable small world index with configurable graph radius and quantization
clone_faiss_index: clone a trained and populated FAISS index including all vectors and metadata
create_scalar_quantizer_index: create a scalar quantizer index with turbo quantization MSE for 1 to 8 bit precision
